title: Al-Qayyum: The Divine Name That Never Appears Alone
excerpt: Al-Qayyum occurs three times in the Quran, and all three times the name al-Hayy stands directly in front of it. Al-Hayy can stand alone. Al-Qayyum never does.
seo_title: Al-Qayyum: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Qayyum appears three times in the Quran — 2:255, 3:2, 20:111 — always joined to al-Hayy. What the name means and why it never stands on its own.
